title: Search Smart: Databases, Keywords and Reliable Sources
objective: Students practice finding biology information using search terms and source evaluation.
outcomes: Use AND, OR, and phrase searching.
Compare search results from different sources.
Evaluate whether a source is reliable for academic use.
activity: Database workshop: students write three keyword searches and choose the most reliable result.
example: To search enzyme activity, a student might use: enzyme activity AND temperature AND plant extract.
